cohort: The study participants were 1145 premature neonates admitted to a tertiary care hospital in Rasht, Iran, between 2017 and 2022.
finding: Fetal sex, gestational age, mode of delivery, five-minute Apgar score, fetal distress, and NICU admission were identified as significant predictors of neonatal mortality at discharge.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was a significant predictor of neonatal mortality at discharge (OR=3.50).
cross-section timing: Data was collected from medical records between 2017 and 2022.
birth_weight: The study included premature neonates, with 94.1% having a birth weight above 2500 g.
gest_age: The study included premature neonates, with 71.9% having a gestational age >= 33 weeks.
